audit_metadata.title: Clinical Prediction Pipeline Methodological Research Audit

architecture_map: CLEANING (NaN identification and target variable binarization)
TARGET PROCESSING (Map categorical labels to binary integers)
TRAIN/TEST SPLIT (80% Train / 20% Test partition via train_test_split)
PREPROCESSING (Imputation, Winsorization, power transforms, OHE scaling fit on training folds)
FEATURE ENGINEERING (Domain clinical ratios, e.g., HOMA-IR, De Ritis Ratio, clinical flags)
FEATURE SELECTION (AFO consensus Borda ranking using MI, L1, XGBoost, and RFE)
CLASS BALANCING (SMOTE + Tomek Links boundary cleaning on training folds)
HYPERPARAMETER OPTIMIZATION (Optuna Bayesian HPO using inner Stratified K-Fold)
MODEL TRAINING (Stacking ensemble HDAGB Classifier: FT-Transformer + GBDTs)
CALIBRATION (Beta calibration fit on out-of-fold train probabilities)
THRESHOLD OPTIMIZATION (Youden's J or F1 optimization on validation folds)
OUTER TEST (Evaluation of saved model pipeline on unseen test fold)
STATISTICAL ANALYSIS (DeLong Bootstrap, McNemar paired classification, Wilcoxon fold tests)
EXPLAINABILITY (TreeSHAP global summary and local patient risk attributions)
VISUALIZATION (Publication-grade 300 DPI ROC, PR, Calibration, and DCA curves)

findings.current_behavior: Splits the raw data 80/20 on the fly, but loads a pipeline model that was fitted on 100% of the raw data, evaluating it on the test partition.
findings.potential_leakage: CRITICAL. The model was trained on the test set, leading to massive target leakage and artificially high validation metrics.
findings.statistical_weakness: Inflated metrics (e.g. 100% accuracy on CKD) that do not reflect true generalization performance.
findings.implementation_weakness: Test samples are included in the final model's fit and preprocessor parameters.
findings.reproducibility_weakness: The validation does not isolate the evaluation fold.
findings.recommended_correction: Train the final pipeline models on the 80% training set only, leaving the 20% test partition completely unseen.

findings.current_behavior: Applies SMOTE and AFO feature selection to the entire training fold before running the inner K-Fold cross-validation split for Optuna hyperparameter optimization.
findings.potential_leakage: HIGH. Preprocessing, feature selection, and resampling are fit on the training fold, which contains validation samples. Synthetic replicas of validation samples generated by SMOTE leak into the inner training folds.
findings.statistical_weakness: Optuna HPO selection is biased towards overfitted hyperparameters because inner validation folds contain leaked information.
findings.implementation_weakness: Failure to isolate preprocessing steps inside the inner cross-validation loop.
findings.reproducibility_weakness: Selected hyperparameters are not robust to new patient datasets.
findings.recommended_correction: Run the inner K-Fold split first. Fit the preprocessor, feature selection, and resampling strictly on the inner training folds, and transform the validation folds.

findings.current_behavior: Optimizes the decision threshold on the SMOTE-balanced training distribution.
findings.statistical_weakness: Optimizing thresholds on balanced synthetic distributions leads to poor decision bounds for highly imbalanced natural prevalence clinical datasets (e.g. specificity collapse in ILPD).
findings.implementation_weakness: Mismatch between training and validation prevalence targets.
findings.reproducibility_weakness: Poor threshold alignment on test datasets.
findings.recommended_correction: Optimize the threshold on out-of-fold predictions that maintain the natural, un-balanced class prevalence.

findings.current_behavior: Fits Beta Calibration using probabilities generated from SMOTE-resampled splits.
findings.statistical_weakness: Beta calibrator scales probabilities based on synthetic prevalences, leading to miscalibrated real-world risk estimates.
findings.implementation_weakness: Miscalibration of probability predictions on natural clinical validation cohorts.
findings.reproducibility_weakness: Inconsistent calibration slopes and ECE on external splits.
findings.recommended_correction: Fit the calibrator on validation predictions that retain original class distributions.
